scenario.description: Long lines wrapping (DESIGN §4.1 "Wrap"): off by default, a long line clips with a fade; Alt Z wraps it at the code column's width, its row as tall as its visual lines and the short removed line beside it as tall, in split and in unified view; Settings › Appearance's Long lines shows Wrap chosen and Scroll turns it off; screenshots of the clipped line, the wrapped split and unified rows, and the settings row.
